location.description: Kiwula Kale Estates: proposed 17-acre coconut holding in the Anamaduwa local-authority area. Exact parcel boundaries and access rights are Unknown.

landRequirement.allocationDetails: Demonstration assumption: request a 15-year agricultural lease, conditional on lawful grant; 16 acres coconut, 0.35 acres service infrastructure, 0.15 acres conservation/drainage, 0.50 acres reserved for a future dairy feasibility decision. No land grant, ownership or current occupation asserted.

policyAlignment.alignmentExplanation: The original pp4 and 8-9 describe coconut supply constraints and domestic demand. This adaptation proposes measured coconut production, local jobs and soil/water management. Applicable national policies and their versions remain Unknown; this rationale is not policy approval.

activities.name: Confirm tenure, access, survey and required studies before works
Set out planting rows and erosion controls only after required permissions
Install irrigation and the watch hut/store after required design review
Establish 1,280 coconut palms and maintain the young plantation
Record water, inputs, employment, costs and harvests
Inspect irrigation weekly and buildings/drainage monthly
Prepare end-of-term restoration and handback proposal; no extension assumed

implementation.oAndMArrangement: Annual preventive maintenance, irrigation inspection weekly, drainage and watch hut/store monthly; LKR 240,000 repairs budget per mature operating year, included once in operating costs. Permissions and technical inspections remain separate.
implementation.oAndMFundingSource: Pre-bearing maintenance is within the funded LKR 1.2m annual early-operation allowance; from revenue years, planned coconut sales fund the mature operating budget. No secured revenue or real funding verification is asserted.
